title: Special Consideration
summary: Mark / outcome adjustment when serious uncontrollable circumstances (illness, bereavement, accident, mental-health crisis) affect performance. Submitted via eForms within 3 working days, requires third-party documentation.

title: Assignment Extension
summary: Extra time to submit a single assessment, approved by the course convener (not the College). Apply BEFORE the due date via Wattle or email.

title: Medical Certificates for Assessments
summary: Requirements for valid medical certificates supporting Special Consideration / Extension. Where to obtain on and off campus, including options for international students with OSHC.

title: Counselling and Mental Health Support
summary: ANU Counselling (free, on campus) for stress, anxiety, low mood, adjustment, grief. Includes after-hours and crisis services (Lifeline, ANU Wellbeing & Support Line, 1800RESPECT, 13YARN).

title: Medical and Health Services on Campus
summary: ANU Medical Centre (Building 156) hours, billing, services. Where to go when ANU is closed. Sexual health, vaccination, pharmacy, after-hours options.

title: Academic Integrity and AI Use
summary: What counts as misconduct (plagiarism, collusion, contract cheating, AI misuse). Course-by-course rules on generative AI. What to do if reported. ANUSA Student Assistance can support you.

title: Access and Inclusion (Education Access Plan)
summary: Formal adjustments for disability, ongoing health condition, mental-health condition, or carer responsibilities. Includes extra exam time, rest breaks, attendance flexibility. Apply via my.anu.edu.au; allow 2-4 weeks.

title: Financial Support and Hardship
summary: Pathways for emergency hardship (ANUSA Student Assistance, Equity Funds), ongoing support (Centrelink, scholarships, on-campus jobs), international student options, fee deferrals and refunds, housing.

title: Course Selection, Enrolment and Census Date
summary: Programs and Courses, ISIS, prerequisites, census date, withdrawal penalties (WD vs WN), cross-institutional study, program transfer, common enrolment mistakes.
